claims.statement: For every count profile with 1 <= m <= 99, every represented tip arity r, and every guarded rank 1 <= k <= floor((N+2)/2), the exact integer tip-surplus expression S_r(k) is nonnegative.
claims.scope: Bounded computation only: all 171699 arity-count profiles with m=1..99, all represented arities, and all 56245000 represented-tip/rank rows; no actual-descent or eligibility filter.
claims.reason: The frozen exact-array instrument completed the entire finite prefix, matched each expected per-m coverage count, and found zero negative rows. The global minimum is 98 with an exact coefficient witness. This evidence does not cover m>=100 or imply a universal surplus theorem.

limitations: Finite exact arithmetic covers only m=1..99; it cannot establish the all-m surplus predicate.
The analytic m>=100 tail, endpoint bridge, guarded comparisons, selected MASS, exact-ratio payment, primary aggregate, and arbitrary-tree claims are outside this computation.
This is bounded computation, not formal verification or a Lean award.
